name: experience-list
title: Experience list
description: A CV section: roles with organisation, dates and duration, a few lines on what was done and skills as tags, in a two-column rhythm that stacks on a phone.
docs: entries is { role, organisation, logo?, start, end?, location?, bullets?, skills? }[], newest first, drawn as an ordered list of articles, each with a heading (the role; headingLevel sets it). Dates sit in a left column, written in months (Mar 2022 – Present) with how long it lasted under them, and move above the details on a phone. A start or end such as 2022-03 is a month and 2022-03-14 a calendar day: neither shifts with timeZone, and a month given as the end counts as worked through, so Jan 2019 to Mar 2023 is 4 yrs 3 mos. A role without an end says Present in words and is measured to now; leave now out to use the browser clock, which the list reads after the first paint (until then the length of a current role is left out, so server and browser agree). Entries with the same organisation next to each other group under one heading with the time at the organisation added up and the roles on a thin timeline. variant education writes years only and no lengths. labels carries the words, with {count} filled in.
